headline: OH MY GIRL's Mimi named face of Korea's rice campaign
sub: Her name fits: 'mi' (米) means rice in Korean
source: Source: Korea Rice Industry Association via Korean media
caption:
OH MY GIRL's Mimi is the new face of Korea's rice consumption campaign!

The Korea Rice Industry Association announced on Nov 23 that it picked Mimi, whose name sounds like 'mi' (米), the character for rice. Her campaign ads, with the tagline 'That's alright, That's all rice', roll out from today on TV, OTT, outdoor and public transit.

📌 Source: Korea Rice Industry Association, via Korean media (CBS NoCut News, Slist)
